_comment: Paths are relative to the root of this release. Every group is students x arms x subsets. Tags are built from the group prefix, the student label, the arm name and the subset label, so a result file says what produced it.
_subsets_gsm8k: three 10% draws from the student half; they overlap, which is why the paired test treats the subset as the unit

qualification.description: fine-tune on the whole student half; a cell is only readable if this moves the base by more than 2 SE

main_gsm8k.description: the three-arm comparison on GSM8K, three subsets per arm

main_math.description: the same three arms on MATH

sham.description: placebo stores: does the benefit need the actual distribution, or only a softer label

width.description: how many stored entries per position the benefit actually needs

temperature.description: distillation temperature, one variable changed against the working point

budget.description: spend the artifact's bytes on more plain text instead: matched-budget control

disqualified.description: cells the validity criterion excludes, run anyway to show what the criterion is protecting against

tau_sweep.description: how much of the corpus the gate should pass, from a tenth of positions to all of them
tau_sweep._thresholds: tau is the quantile of teacher entropy that passes the named fraction of answer positions on subset s11

random_gate.description: a gate that passes the same fraction of positions but picks them without looking at the teacher

label_smoothing.description: a softened one-hot label carrying the teacher's entropy and nothing else about the teacher

seqkd_plus_logits.description: the teacher's own solutions, supervised by the teacher's distribution on that same text

seqkd_plus_logits_q2_15.description: teacher solutions plus their logits, replicated on the second GSM8K cell

seqkd_plus_logits_math.description: teacher solutions plus their logits, on MATH

seqkd_plus_logits_more.description: combined arm, three further subsets, GSM8K cell one

seqkd_plus_logits_q2_15_more.description: combined arm, three further subsets, GSM8K cell two

seqkd_plus_logits_math_more.description: combined arm, three further subsets, MATH

text_only_check.description: text-only arm, run as a reproducibility check

mechanism_q2_15.description: the mechanism controls repeated on a second cell: shams, widths, and the random gate

seqkd_fullD_plus_logits.description: the whole student half rewritten by the teacher, with its logits on top

seqkd_same_trainer.description: sequence-level KD through the shared trainer, cell one

seqkd_same_trainer_q2_15.description: sequence-level KD through the shared trainer, cell two

seqkd_same_trainer_math.description: sequence-level KD through the shared trainer, MATH

degradation_check.description: the cell where fine-tuning on text makes the base model worse, re-measured through the shared trainer

seqlog_cell4_gsm8k_q2_05.description: sequence-level KD plus its logits, additional cell (q2_05)

seqlog_cell5_math_q3_17.description: sequence-level KD plus its logits, additional cell (q3_17)

layer2_selection.description: does choosing sequences by a teacher-derived score beat choosing them at random, at equal token budget

layer2_gated_H.description: sequence selection by entropy in the gated region, the score matched to what the artifact stores

layer2_gated_H_low.description: sequence selection by the LEAST entropy in the gated region, the other end of the scale

layer2_on_written.description: the same selection question on the corpus the teacher rewrote, where the text baseline is already high

layer2_gated_count.description: sequence selection by the number of positions that pass the gate

layer2_gated_count_written.description: the same, on the corpus the teacher rewrote

partition_reference.description: D split into the selected tenth and the rest, on the corpus's own answers

partition_written.description: the same split, on the answers the teacher wrote

partition_q2_15_reference.description: the A / A2 split on the second GSM8K cell, reference answers

partition_q2_15_written.description: the same split on the second GSM8K cell, teacher-written answers

partition_math_reference.description: the A / A2 split on MATH, reference answers

selection_vs_literature.description: our score against the selection rules the literature uses, same budget, GSM8K

partition_math_written.description: the A / A2 split on MATH, on the answers the teacher wrote

partition_math_more_seeds.description: MATH at nine runs per arm instead of three, to say whether its effect is small or absent

literature_more_runs.description: the selection comparison at nine runs, with a fresh random draw behind each control run

literature_q2_15.description: the same comparison on the second GSM8K cell

fold_selection_q15_18.description: the layer-2 criterion with the fold as the unit of generalisation: five disjoint pools, each selected three ways, text-only so the store plays no part

fold_selection_q2_15.description: the same fold design on the second qualified GSM8K base

math_gate30_q2_15.description: MATH re-selected at a corpus-specific gate (tau=0.4404, 29.7% coverage) so the threshold is matched to GSM8K in coverage rather than in nats; the random and high-NLL arms do not depend on tau and are reused from the carried-over-threshold run

fold_selection_math_q2_15.description: the fold design on MATH at the matched-coverage gate

fold_selection_artifact_q15_18.description: the fold design with the store switched on, so the question whether selection and distillation add can be asked at the same power as the text-only comparison

fold_selection_math2_q2_15.description: the fold design on MATH at the matched-coverage gate, with a stratification ladder derived from MATH's own step distribution so that the arms of a fold share a difficulty composition

fold_ape210k_q15_18.description: the fold design on ape210k, text-only, same student as the cell where the criterion works

fold_ecqa_q15_18.description: the fold design on ecqa, text-only, same student as the cell where the criterion works

fold_kk_q15_18.description: the fold design on Knights and Knaves: non-mathematical, but with a near-canonical reference chain

qualify_ecqa.description: the prerequisite: base model against the whole ECQA student half, so the fold arms can be read at all

qualify_kk.description: the prerequisite for Knights and Knaves: the base against the whole student half

fold_selection_q2_15_both_ends.description: the missing ends of the scale on GSM8K / Qwen2-1.5B

fold_selection_q2_05.description: the fold design on a 0.5B base, GSM8K, both gate directions

fold_selection_math_q2_05.description: the same on MATH, at the matched-coverage gate

headroom_probe_gsm8k.description: whole-corpus fine-tune, to see which sub-1B base GSM8K can still teach

headroom_cross_gsm8k.description: whole-corpus fine-tune, students outside the teacher's model family

fold_cross_llama_gsm8k.description: the fold design on Llama-3.2-1B, GSM8K, both gate directions

headroom_cross_ecqa.description: whole ECQA student half, students outside the teacher's family

fold50_llama_gsm8k.description: half-fold budget, Llama-3.2-1B, GSM8K, both gate directions

fold50_anchor_q15_18.description: the same budget on the base where the criterion works, as calibration

w10_llama.description: a tenth of the whole student half against five random tenths

w10_smol.description: a tenth of the whole student half against five random tenths

w10_anchor.description: a tenth of the whole student half against five random tenths

orca_saturation.description: where a small student stops gaining from more Orca-Math

orca_saturation_anchor.description: the same ladder for the model the GSM8K result rests on, so saturation can be read on a corpus 20x larger

fold_orca_anchor_half.description: the criterion on a corpus 20x larger, at a budget the saturation ladder shows is saturated for this student: five disjoint folds of 29,619, each selected at half; includes the length-only control, which wins if the gain is the extra tokens a summed score buys

sat_llama3b_gsm8k.description: is a 3B student outside the teacher's family saturated at the fold budget on GSM8K? three random draws against the whole student half

fold50_llama3b_gsm8k.description: the criterion on a non-Qwen student at the same budget the anchor is saturated at; only run if the probe says this student is saturated too

sat_llama8b_gsm8k.description: the third rung of the non-Qwen size ladder: is an 8B student saturated at 374 sequences on GSM8K?

fold50_llama8b_gsm8k.description: the criterion on a non-Qwen student at saturation, which is what separates family alignment from saturation

fold_llamateacher_q15_18.description: the criterion scored by a Llama-3.2-3B teacher, trained on the same teacher half, selecting for the same Qwen student at the same budget and in the same five folds
